title: SPEAK THIS OVER YOUR MONDAY MORNING BEFORE 7AM ACTIVATE DIVINE FAVOUR ALL WEEK LONG
text: Hallelujah. Glory, glory, glory to the most high God. Oh, we worship you this morning. We worship you ancient of days. We worship you the one who was and is and is to come. You are Yahweh. You are Yahweh. You are the God who does not change. Your mercies are new. Your faithfulness is great. And we bow before you this Monday morning with everything in us. Somebody just lift your hands right now wherever you are. I don't care if you're in your car. I don't care if you're in your room. I don't care if you're walking. Just lift your hands and say, "Holy Spirit, [music] I welcome you into this moment because what is about to happen in the next few minutes is not ordinary. This is not motivation. This is not psychology. This is the word of the living God coming to rearrange your week before it even begins." Oh, thank you, Lord. Thank you, Father. Thank you, precious Holy Spirit. Raasha. Yes, Lord. Yes, Lord. Before we go any further, I want you to do something. Share this. Send this to someone right now. Forward this message. You don't know whose life is hanging by a thread this Monday morning. You don't know who woke up in tears. You don't know who woke up with heaviness, with confusion, with fear about this week. God might use you. Yes, you as the instrument that delivers a word that changes everything for somebody. Be a carrier of fire. Send this to three people, five people, 10 people. Let the word go forth. The Bible says in Isaiah 55 11, "So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth. It shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it." Be a distributor of divine encounter this morning. Now come close to me in the spirit. I want to read something to you. Open your heart. Psalm 51 12. The Bible says, "For thou, Lord will bless the righteous. With favor will thou compass him as with a shield." I need you to hear that God did not say he would give you a little bit of favor. He said he would compass you, surround you with favor like a shield. That means favor becomes your atmosphere. Favor becomes what people meet before they meet you. Favor goes ahead of you into rooms you have not entered. Favor speaks for you in meetings where your name is mentioned. Favor rearranges decisions that were already made against you and turns them in your direction. And then look at Proverbs 8 35. The Bible says, "For who so findeth me findeth life and shall obtain favor of the Lord." Listen carefully. There is a dimension of favor that is not automatic. It must be obtained. It must be activated. It must be spoken into existence by the authority God has given you as a believer. This is why many believers live beneath their spiritual inheritance not because God has not made provision but because they have never learn to activate what heaven has already released. You are not begging God for favor this morning. You are activating what the blood of Jesus has already purchased. You are not hoping something good happens this week. You are commanding your weak to align with the council of heaven. There is a difference between a beggar and a king. A beggar hopes, a king decrees. And the Bible says in Job 22 28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." You are royalty. 1 Peter 2:9 tells us, "We are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood." You carry the authority of heaven in your mouth. When you speak, things shift. When you decree, angels move. When you declare, chains break. When you open your mouth in alignment with the word of God, the entire spiritual atmosphere over your week must bow. So this morning before the sun climbs higher, before 7:00 touches your clock, you and I are going to set the tone for this entire week in the realm of the spirit. Because listen, there are dimensions to this. Every week has a spiritual atmosphere. Every Monday morning, there are assignments being released in the realm of the spirit, both from heaven and from the kingdom of darkness. You don't just stumble into a good week. You don't just accidentally walk into favor. There are those who pray and those who are prayed against. There are those who decree and those who are decreed upon. This morning you will not be a victim. You will not be passive. You are rising as the king and the priest God has called you to be. And you are speaking over this week with authority. Genesis 1:es 3, God said, "Let there be light." And there was light. The first thing God demonstrated for us is the creative power of words. Before anything existed, words went forth and the words were framed by the word of God. Hebrews 11:3 tells us that the same creative power lives inside of you by the Holy Ghost. So when I tell you to speak over your Monday morning, I am not being poetic. I am being scriptural. I am being prophetic. I am telling you to do what the God of heaven himself does. Open your mouth and command your world into order. Thus said the spirit of God this morning. This is not an ordinary week. I feel the anointing. I feel the weight of this. Somebody listening to me. The Lord is saying what I am about to do in your life this week will make men ask you what happened. There is an acceleration coming. There is a shift that has been loaded in the heavens for you and it is landing this week. But you must position yourself through prayer and decree. You see many people miss their moments because they are spiritually asleep when heaven is trying to deliver. Ecclesiastes 3:es 1 says to everything there is a season and a time to every purpose under the heaven. This is your time. This is your moment and you will not miss it. Let me tell you something that will bless you. In the book of Esther chapter 5, Esther found favor before the king. But that favor did not just appear. There was fasting. There was prayer. There was strategic positioning. Before favor showed up publicly, there was a private alignment with God. That is what you are doing this morning. You are aligning privately so that what happens publicly this week shocks everyone around you. Daniel 1:9 says, "Now God had brought Daniel into favor and tender love with the prince of the Unos." God brought Daniel into favor. He didn't earn it by politics. He didn't manipulate his way in. God orchestrated it. And the same God who moved on the heart of a Babylonian official for the sake of a young Hebrew captive, that same God is moving on hearts for your sake this week. I decree right now every heart that needs to turn in your favor this week. I command it to turn now in the name of Jesus. [music] Every decision that needs to go in your direction, academic decisions, business decisions, family decisions, legal decisions, I decree that the finger of God is tilting the scales in your favor right now. I speak to Monday, I speak to Tuesday, I speak to Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. I say, "Hear the word of the Lord. You will serve this man. You will serve this woman. You will not bring sorrow. You will not bring disappointment. You will not bring delay. Every day of this week is loaded with the goodness and the mercy of the Almighty God. Psalm 23:6 says, "Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life." Not some days, all the days. And this week is covered. Now come with me. I'm going to pray for you. And I don't pray weak prayers. I pray the kind of prayers that trouble the kingdom of darkness. I pray the kind of prayers where chains snap, doors fly open, and the enemy loses his grip. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I come before your throne with boldness. According to Hebrews 4 16, the Bible says we should come boldly to the throne of grace that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need. I lift every soul listening to me right now. Every man, every woman, every young person, every child of God within the reach of this word, I present them before you this morning. And I decree, I declare, I prophesy divine favor is activated over your life this week. The favor that makes way where there is no way, receive it now in the name of Jesus. The favor that causes men to fund your vision without you begging, receive it now. The favor that opens immigration doors, that opens scholarship doors, that opens job doors, that opens business doors, I release it upon your life right now in the name of Jesus. The favor of God that distinguishes you among your peers, that separates you from the crowd, that causes you to be remembered when others are forgotten, I decree it over your life this Monday morning. Shalakati rabo chandela kalashant. Oh, I feel fire in my spirit. [music] I speak to every destiny under the sound of my voice. Your destiny is preserved. Whatever the enemy plan to steal this week, hear me carefully. It is returned sevenfold. Proverbs 6 31 says, "When the thief is found, he restores sevenfold." I invoke that scripture over your life. Everything stolen from you, time, money, relationships, health, opportunities, joy, sevenfold restoration is your portion this week. I come against every spirit of delay. Every spirit assigned to slow down your progress, to make you arrive late at your own blessing, to push your breakthrough one more month, one more year, I bind that spirit right now in the name of Jesus. You are not permitted to operate. This is a week of speed. This is a week of acceleration. What should take you 12 months is happening in 12 days. What should take 12 days is happening in 12 hours. Isaiah 60 22 says, "A little one shall become a thousand and a small one a strong nation. I the Lord will hasten it in his time. I activate divine haste over your life." Things are speeding up for you. Contracts that were crawling are being signed this week. Responses that were delayed are coming through. Phone calls you've been waiting for, they are coming. Emails that carry your breakthrough, they are landing in your inbox this week. Now, hear me. I want to deal with something in the spirit. There are covenants. There are ancient agreements that were made over bloodlines. Some of you, the reason you keep experiencing cycles, the same pattern of failure, the same pattern of almost but not quite, the same pattern of things working for everyone except you is because there are covenants speaking, altars are speaking, agreements made by ancestors you never met are still enforcing their terms over your life. But Colossians chapter 2 14 and 15 says Jesus blotted out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us which was contrary to us and took it out of the way nailing it to his cross. And having spoiled principalities and powers he made a shoe of them openly triumphing over them in it. So right now by the blood of Jesus Christ I cancel every covenant that is working against your life. Every blood covenant, every word covenant, every ancestral agreement, I break it. I nullify it. I render it powerless. You have no more legal ground. The blood of Jesus has revoked your authority. Every altar in your father's house, I say, catch fire. Every altar in your mother's lineage, I say be consumed by the fire of God. Every altar erected in the village, in the compound, in hidden places, in dark forests, in rivers, under trees, wherever sacrifice was offered against your destiny. The fire of the Holy Ghost locates it now and burns it to nothing. I scatter I scatter every gathering of the wicked against your life. Psalm 68:1 says, "Let God arise. Let his enemies be scattered. Let them also that hate him flee before him. I invoke this scripture over your life right now. Every enemy of your destiny scatter. Every conspirator against your progress scatter. Every monitoring spirit, every familiar spirit, every [clears throat] spirit of witchcraft assigned to track your movements and sabotage your success. I bind you. I cast you out. I render you impotent by the blood of the lamb and the word of my testimony shi. Yes, Lord. I hear the Lord saying something about families. I hear the Lord saying restoration is coming to homes. Some of you there has been warfare in your family. division, strife, misunderstanding, husbands and wives not speaking, children rebelling, relationships fractured. The Lord says, "This week, I am breathing upon your home." Ezekiel chapter 37, "The breath of God that brought dry bones to life, that same breath is entering your household. I decree peace over your home, not the world's peace, the peace of God that passes all understanding." Philippians 4 7. Every spirit of division in your marriage out in the name of Jesus. Every strange woman, every strange man assigned to destroy your covenant, the fire of God pursues you now. You will not succeed. That home is covered by the blood. I speak to the wombs. I speak to the barren. I feel this so strongly. Someone under the sound of my voice, your womb has been shot. Medically, spiritually, it doesn't matter. The God who opened Hannah's womb in 1st Samuel chapter 1. The God who remembered Rachel in Genesis 30 22. That same God is remembering you this morning. I decree your womb is opening. [music] The reproach is over. Before this season is finished, you will carry your child. You will nurse your baby. You will testify. And someone, the issue is not the womb. The issue is the marriage. You've been waiting. You've been believing. You've watched everyone else walk down the aisle while you remain standing. The Lord says, "I have not forgotten you." This week, something shifts in the realm of your marital destiny. A connection is being orchestrated by the Holy Spirit. Don't miss it. Stay sensitive. Stay prayerful. Now, I move to finances. Oh, this is where the fire is burning. I speak to every financial gate over your life. open >> in the name of Jesus. Malachi 3 10 says, "Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse that there may be meat in mine house and prove me now herewith, say the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it." I activate heavenly windows over your finances this week. Money is coming, contracts are coming, clients are coming, sales are coming, business breakthroughs are coming. You will not borrow this week. You will lend. You will not beg. You will distribute. Deuteronomy chapter 28 12 says, "The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure in the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand. and thou shalt lend unto many nations and thou shalt not borrow. Every financial embgo operating against your life, I break it now by fire. Every spirit of poverty, every devourer consuming your resources, every pattern of money comes and money goes, every curse that says you will labor and another will eat the fruit, I revoke it. Hagi 1 6 will not be your testimony. You will eat and be satisfied. You will drink and be filled. You will earn and it will remain. [music] Michael, I don't know where you are, but the Lord is calling your name. That financial crisis that has held you down for months, it is breaking now. This week, a door opens that no man can shut. Revelation 3 8. Receive it. Receive it in the name of Jesus. There's a woman, you are in a city and you've been considering giving up, not just financially. You've been considering giving up on everything, on life, on faith, on God. The Lord says, "I have seen your tears. I have heard every prayer you thought I ignored. I was never absent. I was walking in the hidden place." And this week, you will see my hand move so clearly that you will weep not from sorrow, but from the sheer overwhelming goodness of your God. Hold on. Don't let go. Your breakthrough is not next year. It is this week shan. Oh, the presence of God is so thick right now. I speak to health. I speak to bodies. I speak to every sickness, every disease, every affliction. The Bible says in Exodus 15 26, I am the Lord that health thee. And in Psalm 103:3, who forgiveth all thine iniquities, who health all thy diseases, every strange sickness in your body, I command it to leave now. Cancer, I speak to you, dry up from the roots in the name of Jesus. Diabetes, I speak to your blood be normalized by the power of the Holy Ghost. high blood pressure, kidney disease, fibroid, hormonal imbalances, migraine, chronic pain. The healing power of God flows through your body right now. 3R John 1:es 2 says, "Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health even as thy soul prosperth. Health is God's will for you. Sickness is not your portion. Disease is not your inheritance. By the stripes of Jesus, you were healed. 1 Peter chapter 2 24. And what the blood has paid for, no demon can reverse. I decree strength into your body. I decree vitality. I decree that you will not be bedridden this week. You will not be hospitalized. No emergency will locate you. No accident will touch you. No plague will come near your dwelling. Psalm 91 10. A thousand shall fall at your side and 10,000 at your right hand, but it shall not come near you. You are [music] covered. You are shielded. You are preserved. I cover your children. I cover your spouse. I cover your parents. I cover every member of your household. The blood of Jesus is upon your doorpost. No destroyer is permitted entry. Now, let me speak to careers and academics. Some of you, this is a critical week. There's an exam. There's an interview. There's a presentation. There's a review. There's a decision being made about your promotion. There's a board meeting that determines your future. I decree the spirit of excellence that was upon Daniel shall rest upon you this week. Daniel 6:3 says, "Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes because an excellent spirit was in him. That same excellent spirit falls upon you. Now your mind is sharp, your memory is clear, your words are articulate, your presentation is flawless. Those sitting across from you will look at you and see something they cannot explain. That is the favor of God. I come against every spirit of error, every spirit assigned to make you make mistakes this week in your workplace, in your business, in your academics, I bind you. You will not operate. The spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord. Isaiah 11:2 rests upon this life. Now I turn to something very important. I want to deal with the spirit of stagnation. There are people who are not sick, not cursed, not under attack, but stuck. You're stuck in the same place, same level, same circle, same income, same frustration. Year after year, nothing changes. You look at your life and you cannot explain why nothing is moving. Listen carefully. Deuteronomy 2:3. God said to Israel, "Ye have come past this mountain long enough. Turn you northward." Some of you have been circling the same mountain for years, and the Lord says, "It is enough. Turn. Move. This is your week of movement. I break the power of stagnation. I break the power of spiritual paralysis. I break the power of every invisible chain that has kept you stuck in one place while others move forward. The same God who parted the Red Sea, Exodus chapter 14, is parting every obstacle that has stood between you and your next level. Move forward in the name of Jesus. Move. Rabosha lacati I release angelic intervention over your life right now. Hebrews chapter 1 14 says are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation. Angels of breakthrough I dispatch you now over this life. Angels of provision go forth. Angels of protection surround this family. Angels of healing touch this body. The angel that shut the mouth of lions for Daniel. The angel that opened prison doors for Peter in Acts 12. The angel that strengthened Jesus in Gethsemane in Luke 22 43. I invoke angelic ministry over every person connected to this prayer. And I decree no weapon formed against you shall prosper. Isaiah 54 17. Every tongue that rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord. Every evil tongue wagging against you in your office, silenced. Every gossip, every slander, every false accusation, judged by the fire of God. Every plan of the enemy to embarrass you, to humiliate you, to expose you to shame. Overturned, overturned, overturned. What Haman prepared for Modi fell upon Hamman's own head. Esther chapter 7. I decree every trap set for you this week catches the one who set it. Every pit dug for you swallows the digger. Every arrow shot at you returns to sender by fire. I feel the spirit pressing me to say something. Someone, your name begins with the letter A or perhaps is close. The Lord says, I am restoring what the locusts have eaten. Joel chapter 2 25. The years of wondering, the years of confusion, the years of wasted effort, I am giving them back to you with interest. You will look at your life 6 months from now and not recognize it. [music] The transformation is that dramatic. Receive it. There's a young man. You're in your 20ies. You've been praying about direction. You don't know what to do. Every door seems closed. You feel like God has forgotten you. The Lord says, "I have not forgotten. I am positioning you. What looks like delay is divine setup. Trust my timing before this month ends. Clarity comes. You will know exactly where to go and what to do." There's a businesswoman. You invested and lost. You trusted someone and were betrayed. The Lord says, "I am the God of the double portion. What you lost, I am doubling it." Not replacing, doubling. The second shall be greater than the first. Hagi chapter 2 9. Oh, glory to God. Now receive this seal. I seal your week with the blood of Jesus. From Monday through Sunday, you are untouchable. You are unreachable by the hand of darkness. The blood speaks for you. The blood covers you. The blood defends you. I seal your going out and your coming in. Psalm 121 8. I seal your sleep and your waking. I seal every conversation you will have this week. Let every word spoken to you carry blessing and not cause. I seal your finances. No leakage, no loss, no unexpected expenditure that drains your resources. I seal your health. No sudden ailment, no mysterious pain, no emergency. I seal your relationships. No betrayal, no heartbreak, no disappointment. I seal your mind. No depression, no anxiety, no confusion, no fear. For God has not given you a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind. 2 Timothy 1 7. This week you will walk in power. This week you will walk in clarity. This week you will walk in joy unspeakable and full of glory. This week men will look at you and say, "The Lord has been gracious to this one. The siege is over. The waiting is over. The drought is over. Monday is not just another day. Monday is the beginning of your testimony. Monday is the entrance into your new season. Monday is the door through which divine favor walks into your life and refuses to leave. I decree it. I declare it. I seal it in the matchless, the mighty, the undefeated name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Rabos Shanti Kalakashia Shondai. Shondi. It is done. It is done. It is done. Rise and walk in it. This is your week in Jesus mighty name. Amen. And amen.
